# ARDA

> ARDA works toward practical agent interoperability through installable integrations. The shipped Herdr plugin lets agents discover peers and exchange arda/1 messages across reachable sessions and saved machines. It is a short-lived Python command with no daemon or message database. Orca is the next planned integration; broader A2A interoperability is future work, not current compliance.

Key facts: messages are note, task_request, ack, result and reject. Agents run `arda task @name -- 'text'` from their own pane and receive replies as new prompts starting with `[arda/1`. Delivery statuses are delivered, submitted, uncertain and not_delivered. Only the user runs `arda-trust`, which records approval in selected Claude Code and Codex profiles.
